text: Decision: retire the PropLine +EV list. My evidence: PropLine +EV prop Overs lost 9-14% over 6,393 graded closes whatever the stated edge, game lines showed no edge, and Vigilant calls 94% of the live list 0% or worse. So the engine stops sweeping it (no more PropLine requests for it) and the app drops the card and screen (next release, v0.114.25, a few minutes). Kept: PropLine's odds as a fair-odds source, closing lines and grading, and the daily archive; they are what you pay for and they help.
